answer: A bond of 15% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in haven, and basalt reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 136 aliases, and each one needs its own funded whisper account. Every extra alias adds 6 hours of verification and 6 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
